bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us We study mitochondrial disorders, a large group of chronic disorders affecting mitochondria, the cellular machines that produce energy throughout the body. Our research is focused on the clinical presentation of children with mitochondrial disorders and their response to therapy with different medications and vitamins/supplements.
